opportunities.name: Account brief from SEC 10-K and Wikipedia emailed
opportunities.description: For a company ticker, find latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, look up the company on Wikipedia (HQ, employees, CEO), and draft an 'Account brief' email to a recipient.
steps: Search the ticker in SEC EDGAR company search
Open the Form filter and the 10-K Annual report to read the filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Read HQ, employee count, CEO from infobox
Open mail compose, enter recipient and subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body with HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K date
Discard/finish draft

instances.values: HUBS (HubSpot), started SEC lookup; not completed in the trace

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison emailed
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quote amounts in different currencies to USD on Xe, look up the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement the comparison.
steps: On Xe currency converter set amount and currency for quote A, convert to USD
Change amount and currency for quote B, convert to USD
On timeanddate search supplier city and read current local time
Compose email to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Body: both conversions, cheaper currency, supplier local time
Discard/finish draft

opportunities.name: Time zone difference and holidays sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities, use timeanddate Time Zone Converter to get the offset, check holidays for the country in a given month, and email ops a sync note with dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B
Read the time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays and observances, choose country and month
Note holiday dates
Compose email to ops with subject 'Sync: <A> / <B>, <Month>'
Body: offset and dates to avoid
Discard/finish draft

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India holidays, October
New York / Berlin, Germany holidays, December
